newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem invests in aluminium cast houses.
newsitem.headline: Elkem invests in aluminium cast houses.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Friday it planned to invest 108 million crowns in the cast houses of its two aluminium plants at Lista in southern Norway and Mosjoeen in the north of the country.
Elkem said the investment was part of a technological development project aimed at cutting costs in the foundries.
As a result there will be a division of work between the plants, Elkem said. The Lista plant will produce aluminium billets, while Mosjoeen will produce rolling slabs and foundry alloys.
